title: LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - CELEBRATION & HOPE
lines: 01 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - CELEBRATION & HOPE

DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting [Celebration & Hope], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from all past Standard Headhuntings up to and including [Confirmation, Completion, Conduction] Standard Headhunting:

Lee / Goldenglow / Fiammetta / Horn / Irene / Ebenholz / Dorothy / Pozëmka / Młynar / Stainless / Penance / Reed the Flame Shadow / Lin / Qiubai / Ines / Ho'olheyak / Executor the Ex Foedere / Typhon / Swire the Elegant Wit / Jessica the Liberated / Hoederer / Viviana / Degenbrecher / Ray / Zuo Le / Ascalon / Logos / Ulpianus / Nymph / Narantuya / Vina Victoria / Vulpisfoglia / Thorns the Lodestar
Note:
- [Celebration & Hope] is part of the [Special Headhunting] headhunting series.
- Please refer to the official notice of the [Special Headhunting] for more details.
02 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Rhodes Island Headhunting Pack (Limited to 2 purchases)
Players need to choose one option from the following when purchasing this headhunting pack:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Ascalon, Typhon, Ho'olheyak)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Lemuen, Nymph, Jessica the Liberated)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Goldenglow, Reed the Flame Shadow, Gnosis)

Players will receive the chosen custom headhunting permit upon purchase. The selected permit can be used to perform a [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] that guarantees one random 6-star Operator from its pool.
[Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]
- You may select only one of the Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits and you can only purchase it twice. You cannot change your decision after purchasing.

- The permit is good for [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. While performing any rolls in [Half Year Anniv. Headhunting], rolls that do not give a 6-star Operator will not count towards the 6-star protection mechanism, nor will it affect your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting]. Rates are also not affected by your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting].

- For this Headhunting, players are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6-star Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] pool chosen.
NOTE:
- Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: August 19, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- You may only use this Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, its Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.
- If not used by the expiration date, this Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Aside from a guaranteed 6-star Operator from the selected Headhunting Permit, the pull rates for the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] are as follows:
★6 Operator: 2%
★5 Operator: 8%
★4 Operator: 50%
★3 Operator: 40%
Rhodes Island Special Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 51, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Orundum * 2100, Module Data Block * 4
Advanced Training Resource Pack
CONTENTS: Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2, Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1

Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has not yet been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
Wish Upon A Star Pack
CONTENTS: Dynamic Theme [Envisioning] * 1, Dynamic Background [Startrail] * 1
Note:
- Wish Upon A Star Pack is currently available at its first-launch discount price.
- Both dynamic Theme and dynamic Background can change into different forms under certain conditions.
Please stay tuned for more information!
